title: Refunds on Entry & Patio Door Contracts: Tender and Timing
content:
Under Entry & Patio Door Contracts, a refund returns money from one specific earlier payment and is never larger than what remains unrefunded of that payment.

## Where the money goes

| Source payment tender | Refund returned to |
|---|---|
| Card | The card the payment came from |
| ACH | The bank account the payment came from |
| Check | A mailed check |
| Lender funding | Never refunded to the customer; returned to the lender by the financing account's terms |

## No second refund of a fully refunded payment

A door payment that has already been refunded in full is never refunded again. Whether a payment has been refunded, and by how much, is read from the refunds already recorded against that payment as their source.

## Timing

A non-cooling-off refund is issued within the refund window counted in business days from the date it becomes due.

## Hypothetical payments

| Source payment | Already refunded against it | Most that can still be refunded against it |
|---|---|---|
| $1000.00 card payment | $0.00 | $1000.00, to the same card |
| $1000.00 card payment | $400.00 | $600.00, to the same card |
| $1000.00 card payment | $1000.00 | Nothing: refunded in full |
| $2500.00 check payment | $0.00 | $2500.00, by mailed check |
| Lender funding | Any | Nothing to the customer |
